title: Next.js Review Quiz
description: Review the small examples from this Next.js course. Take your time and read the reason given for each answer.

questions.question: Which file defines the App Router home page?
questions.explanation: A page.tsx file defines what a route shows. In the app folder, page.tsx is the home page.

questions.question: What address matches app/books/page.tsx?
questions.explanation: A folder with its own page.tsx makes a route. The folder name becomes part of the web address.

questions.question: What does Link need in href?
questions.explanation: Next.js Link makes navigation between local routes. It preserves normal link meaning while allowing the framework to handle the move.

questions.question: What does children represent in this layout?
options: The page or nested layout inside it
questions.explanation: A layout wraps pages that belong under it. The root layout includes the html and body elements for the app.

questions.question: What does metadata.title change?
questions.explanation: Metadata gives a page a browser title and search description. Static values can be exported from a server page file.

questions.question: Why does this component use use client?
options: It must keep a server password
It needs browser interaction and React state
questions.explanation: A Client Component can use browser state and click handlers. The use client line marks that boundary.

questions.question: Which prop crosses the boundary here?
questions.explanation: A server page can pass simple serialisable values into a Client Component. The client can then use the values for interaction.

questions.question: What URL serves public/club.svg?
questions.explanation: Files in public are served from the site root. Their folder name is not included in the public URL.

questions.question: How does JSX use the module class?
questions.explanation: A CSS module gives a component named classes that are scoped by the build. It helps avoid collisions with another component's class names.

questions.question: Why provide generateStaticParams for these exported pages?
options: To make every possible address exist
To name the routes that must be built
questions.explanation: A dynamic route folder uses a value from the address. Static export needs to know its allowed values at build time.

questions.question: What should a useful missing-page view include?
options: A clear message and a way to continue
questions.explanation: A not-found file supplies a useful message when the app reaches a missing page. Give the reader a way back.

questions.question: Which folder contains the static export?
questions.explanation: A static export builds files that a static host can serve. Browser interactions can still work without a runtime application server.
